question: Who wins the Alaska Senate race in 2026
quote: I think Peltola ekes it out probably at the end of November.
turn_text: Yeah, one quick word before we get off of the prairie states. My universal theory of the case in the prairie states is that Republicans are being underpolled and they will show up. If they don't, then everything goes, including Kansas, including Nebraska, which we hadn't talked about. In the generational wipeout scenario, I don't think Ricketts makes it. But when it comes to Alaska, Peltola has been shedding support even before the Dan Sullivan scandal was fully exposed. But she was at over 50 percent about a couple of weeks ago. But Sullivan's vote share has been very stable and not moving in the right direction. I'm not confident that this is a hold for the GOP. So at the very end of this whole thing, once ranked choice voting is accounted for everything, I don't think that Republicans hold it. I think Peltola ekes it out probably at the end of November.
host_quote: But Jim Garrity, we have a nip and tuck race in Alaska where there's some last-minute drama. Who's going to win?
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Alaska US Senate general election, after ranked-choice tabulation if no candidate has a first-round majority. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
